description: Under the cover of night, the investigators rest at the hotel and formulate their next plan, with characters interacting while slacking off.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Unfortunately, I am a medical student."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar scoffs at the medical student? You have no idea what you're messing with!

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Ah, I understand now."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh dear."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Oh, you mean a deity, right?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "But what I see before me is just a human."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "To be honest, we've probably seen more than you've heard of."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Gag his mouth for me."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Then why don't you guess whether the people your master is spying on have any understanding of this sort of thing?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will surely be answered. <player5>'s intimidating prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: [Quality]

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Gags Caesar's mouth.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar writhes violently in the ropes, veins bulging on his forehead, throat emitting muffled roars like a trapped beast.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Next, I will soak these pieces of paper, one by one, and then stick them, one by one, onto your face."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar suddenly stops struggling, sweat-soaked red hair plastered to his pale forehead. He bends his bound knees and thumps them heavily on the floor, throat emitting a muffled whimper.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Sneaks out quietly.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Removes the sock used to gag him.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar coughs up saliva tinged with blood. "I'll talk... I'll tell you everything..." The lock of black hair droops limply behind his ear. "Termona is looking for Winkelmann's eighth medal... He hopes you can find it, so he sent me to follow you."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ah, wouldn't it have been easier to cooperate earlier?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar's pupils suddenly dilate. "R'lyeh is the Lord of the Caverns..." His voice suddenly becomes chant-like and hollow. "His breath becomes the Bora, His scales are the origin of stalactites... We shall attain eternal life within His abdomen..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What do you want? What happened three years ago?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The medal is part of the key... to open the passage for His descent..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Remains silent.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar blinks blankly. "Three years ago? I've only been following Termona for eleven months..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Tell us how you got involved with your master."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I heard the call of the Lord in my dreams at night, went to the Postumia Cave, and then joined the divine organization. Since then, I have devoted my life to the God." Caesar trembles, revealing a ghastly smile. "But... Termona's left hand... was taken back by Him personally. On days when the medal cannot be found, the Bora takes the limbs of the believers... first fingers... then the whole arm... We can only try to find any mysterious items to barely appease the God." The wind outside the window suddenly turns mournful and howls.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I see. Do you have any other questions?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "For now, he's not an enemy."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Wait, Termona's left hand..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Glances outside.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Did your master connect something else to him?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar's collar suddenly tore open, revealing a pale, constantly writhing tentacle. See? This is both a blessing and a curse... The tip of that tentacle split open into a star-shaped maw. Termona's left hand can now flip through ten books at once!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "So what's your blessing?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar muttered obsessively: Find the medal... R'lyeh will grant any wish. Wealth, immortality... even bringing the dead back to life.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This thing, maybe all the cultists are infected."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Wishful thinking, have you heard of the Monkey's Paw?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Caesar suddenly convulsed violently, the tentacles burrowing into his eye sockets and mouth like frenzied pythons. "Impossible, Lord R'lyeh! Lord R'lyeh!" Blood gushed from his seven orifices. With the wet sound of viscera being torn, he collapsed in a pool of blood. The tentacles twitched one last time and retracted into his chest cavity, leaving only a hollow cavity.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Hmm, we can check if he's still alive."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Too bad he's dead."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Alright, alright, I'm rolling...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Because the tentacles tore the skin into pieces,

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Take a nap first, go to the Dreamlands to complain to Cat Mom.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm, who's responsible for dumping the body?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Pacing back and forth outside the door.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Tired, I'm resting first."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Don't rush, let's clean up the body first."

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Sleep!

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Qiduo doesn't understand—oh no, going to get my salary docked by the head maid again.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The Bora wind turns the streets into a howling maze of gray and white, cobblestones slam against building exteriors like cannonballs. The entire street's chain railings are shaking violently, a vendor's cart is overturned, oranges roll into the gutter and are instantly coated in ice. In the distance, the harbor foghorn continues its mournful, wailing alarm.
